Rendering probe 2
Images, logos and backgrounds
A — The same mark, two ways
Left has white baked into the image. Right is the identical mark on transparency. This is the single most important comparison in the file. After conversion, does the left one sit in a bright white box?
white background baked in
transparent background
B — A photograph
A full width image with its own colours. This one should come back completely untouched — confirming that photos are never recoloured.
C — Logo inside a white card
The mark again, this time on a card the converter will darken. If the card turns dark and the image keeps its white box, the seam between them is the problem to look at.
Card is #ffffff, border is #e3e6ea
D — Text over a background image
The image is set with background-image rather than an <img> tag, with white text on top. Does the text stay readable against it?
White heading over an image
and a line of supporting text beneath it
E — Icons as inline SVG
Three icons drawn as inline <svg>, filled with dark colours. Are they still visible after conversion, or do they stay dark on a dark surface?
